description.narrative: The main expected project-level outcomes are environmental effects via improved energy and water use efficiency. Beyond the project, IFC anticipates that the investment will promote sustainability in the Indonesian retail property sector via demonstration and replication channels. Supporting a leading retail developer in Indonesia to green its portfolio will provide a highly visible demonstration case which could have a catalytic impact on the retail and logistics property market in the country.

The proposed investment is an up to IDR 851 billion (US$53 million equivalent) sustainability-linked loan (SLL) facility to various subsidiaries of PT Nirvana Wastu Pratama (NWP or the Company) with a maturity of up to 11 years. The loan will be used for the refinancing of NWPs retail mall and hotel property assets in Indonesia. NWP is a rapidly expanding consumer real estate platform focused on retail and logistics properties in Indonesia. It currently has 53 properties 36 in operation and 17 under development with a combined gross floor area (GFA) of 1.24 million square meters (sqm) upon completion. NWP is backed by strong institutional investors, led by Warburg Pincus (majority ownership of 54%), a leading global private equity firm with a proven track record of investing in Asia real estate across multiple asset classes.
